redTestChanges.reason: Not a spec-correctness fix — a fixture-construction defect in the [inline] test 'entry.json carries inline: { skippedStages, reason, note, size }, derived from exported constants, and the key is null on every other run'. Its --skipped-stages/--inline-note refusal loop reused the same `root` fixture the test had already used for an earlier, successful runInline(root) call in the same test body, which leaves a real .sdd/ledger/<RUN_ID>/ directory on that root. assertInlineRefusal's own assertNothingWritten(root, why) (assert.deepEqual(ledgerRunIds(root), [], ...)) can therefore never pass against that root regardless of how the two flags are implemented or rejected -- there is no legitimate way for an unrelated flag-validation refusal to make an already-written, legitimate ledger entry disappear. Fixed by giving each loop iteration its own fresh fixture root (fixtureRepo({ pipeline: inlinePipeline() }) + inlineEditOnDisk(...)), the same construction this same test already uses two lines later for its 'plain run' check, for the identical reason. Every original assertion (unrecognized-flag rejection via assertInlineRefusal, and the exact stderr match) is unchanged; only the fixture each iteration runs against changed. Verified before (121/122, this exact test the only failure) and after (122/122) in scripts/ledger-append.test.mjs; no other test in the file was touched.
